entities.summary: Mary Denisse Munive Angermüller is a Costa Rican physician and politician who has been the Second Vice-President of Costa Rica under First Vice-President Stephan Brunner and President Rodrigo Chaves Robles since 2022. She has been the Minister of Health since 2023, and was also the Minister of Sports.
